route.name: Harderwijk - Barneveld incl. founders house 50km ENG 2024

course_points.n: Start of ride; water on your left
Turn slightly right, follow the junction system to junction 11
Turn right; cross street to junction 11
Turn left to junction 46; cross street
At roundabout take exit 2 to junction 80
Turn left, then instantly right; leave the junction system
End of ride, Restaurant The Gribus to your right
